title: Graph-to-Grid (G2G): Continuous-Coordinate Feature Painting for Soccer Pass Surfaces
abstract: arXiv:2609.24040v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dense pass surfaces give, for every pitch cell, whether a pass played there would arrive, whether the carrier would choose it, and what the possession would then be worth. The networks that draw them read the state as a raster of per-cell counts, losing where inside a cell each player stands. LiDAR detectors, bird's-eye-view perception and graph weather models move entity features onto a grid, binning each entity to a cell or learning the transfer. We evaluate the interpolated form: each player's features are scattered bilinearly onto the grid at the player's measured coordinates, so the surface loss trains the per-player encoder end to end. Those systems adopt an interface; this paper measures one. On 53,628 passes from the 2022 World Cup, painting improves selection likelihood over the same core fed rasters alone by about a quarter of a nat: in every match of an eight-fold cross-validation, with every arm tuned over five seeds, and aft

translated_title: 图到网格（G2G）：用于足球传球表面的连续坐标特征绘制
translated_abstract: 密集传球表面为球场的每个单元格提供信息：在该处传出的球是否会到达、持球者是否会选择这次传球，以及该次控球随后价值几何。绘制这些表面的网络将比赛状态读取为逐单元格计数的栅格，从而丢失了每个球员在单元格内部的具体站位。激光雷达检测器、鸟瞰图感知和图天气模型将实体特征移动到网格上，将每个实体分箱到某个单元格，或学习这种转换。我们评估了插值形式：每个球员的特征在其测量的坐标处通过双线性插值散布到网格上，因此表面损失可以端到端地训练每个球员的编码器。那些系统采用了一种接口；本文则对一种接口进行了测量。在2022年世界杯的53,628次传球上，特征绘制方法相比仅输入栅格的相同核心模型，将选择可能性提高了约四分之一奈特：在八折交叉验证的每场比赛中，每个分支在五个随机种子上进行了调优，并且……
tldr: 本文提出Graph-to-Grid（G2G）方法，将球员特征按实测连续坐标双线性插值绘制到网格上，而非使用逐单元格计数的栅格，在2022年世界杯53,628次传球数据上将传球选择可能性的预测提升约四分之一奈特。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Graph-to-Grid (G2G), which paints player features onto a grid via bilinear interpolation at measured continuous coordinates instead of per-cell count rasters, improving pass selection likelihood by about a quarter of a nat on 53,628 passes from the 2022 World Cup.
